about: The domain registry. Every list of domains in the observatory (dictionary page, catalog, overview, chat, docs) is read from this file; nothing else may hard-code a domain name or the number of domains. To add a domain, add one object to 'domains' and run: python contract.py. Field rules and the placement guide: docs/adding-data.md. Old ids and names that links may still carry map to the current ids in legacy_names (2026-11-04, decision 81: economy.public-money is public-money, environment.hazards is hazards).
